name: MWSTEEL4-scene-a-unit-forward
note: A unit off front to back: the forearm's line no longer runs through the cuffs.

name: MWSTEEL4-scene-a-unit-high
note: A unit off in height: the cuffs ride under the forearm and the ankles stand too far over the soles.

name: MWSTEEL4-the-skirt-hangs-stiff
note: The pelvis alone carries the skirt: the bake no longer makes the shipped skirt (mwsteel1's re-make), and a skirt re-baked so stands stiff on the hem (mwsteel4).

name: MWSTEEL4-the-gauntlet-named-for-the-other-hand
note: Rule 15's filter would take the right gauntlet's geometry for the left hand.

name: MWSTEEL4-no-joint-with-the-parent
old: if (dot(sub(p, b.from), axis[k]) < L) { const w = across(p, k); return [[k, w], [index.get(b.parent), 1 - w]]; }
new: if (false) { const w = across(p, k); return [[k, w], [index.get(b.parent), 1 - w]]; }

name: MWSTEEL4-no-joint-with-a-child
old: if (dot(sub(p, bones[j].from), axis[j]) > -L && (c < 0 || d[j] < d[c])) c = j;
new: if (dot(sub(p, bones[j].from), axis[j]) > L && (c < 0 || d[j] < d[c])) c = j;

name: MWSTEEL4-a-linear-joint
old: export const smoothstep = (x) => (x <= 0 ? 0 : x >= 1 ? 1 : x * x * (3 - 2 * x));

name: MWSTEEL4-the-bias-ignored
old: const d = bones.map((b) => segmentDistance(p, b.from, b.to) - (b.bias ?? 0));
new: const d = bones.map((b) => segmentDistance(p, b.from, b.to));

name: MWSTEEL4-no-weld
old: if (g === undefined) { g = first.length; at.set(k, g); first.push(v); }
note: Each vertex its own group: a seam's two vertices weighted apart.

name: MWSTEEL4-the-bind-written-for-its-inverse
old: return { name: b.name, data: { transform: { rotation: inv.a, translation: inv.t, scale: 1 }, center: sphere.center, radius: sphere.radius, indices, weights: ws } };
new: return { name: b.name, data: { transform: { rotation: b.bind.a, translation: b.bind.t, scale: 1 }, center: sphere.center, radius: sphere.radius, indices, weights: ws } };

name: MWSTEEL4-the-plate-solved-at-runtime-again
note: A runtime skin for a piece shipped skinned: it goes to bindSkinnedFromBody and, with no body under it, is not drawn.
